author: nc1234
content:
I think this is worth flagging. `execution_payload_availability[F]` is always 1. I think what we need is 
```
        execution_payload_availability=ExecutionPayloadAvailability([
            0b0 if index == pre.slot % SLOTS_PER_HISTORICAL_ROOT else 0b1
            for index in range(SLOTS_PER_HISTORICAL_ROOT)
        ]),
```
at fork transition

author: nc1234
content: There is also one issue that at fork transition we set `state.latest_execution_payload_bid.slot` to 0 [here](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/f221a044e575fc8d7b400e9cf4061e8c11db6730/specs/gloas/fork.md?plain=1#L207), which means `parent_slot` [here](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/f221a044e575fc8d7b400e9cf4061e8c11db6730/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md?plain=1#L1665) is 0 and `payload_index` [here](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/f221a044e575fc8d7b400e9cf4061e8c11db6730/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md?plain=1#L1311) is always 1 for block at F.
